subject: Integration roadmap, ownership, and go-live commitments
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astralog.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nisha Rao <nisha.rao@astralog.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP + proposed go-live window

Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is our internal draft of the mutual action plan (Astra_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a simple list of priorities from our side. High level:

- Target go-live window: 2028-03-20 to 2028-03-27 (preferred: 03/22)
- Critical: PCI tokenization path + regional routing to us-east-1
- Non-blocking but high priority: KV cache hit rate improvements for chat flows

We'd like a concise rollout schedule with named owners so our procurement and infra teams can lock dates. Can your team propose milestone owners and an acceptance checklist?

Attaching: Astra_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Integrations
Astra Logistics
[attachment: Astra_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astralog.com>
Cc: Nisha Rao <nisha.rao@astralog.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 13:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + proposed go-live window

Liam —

Appreciate the MAP you sent. I reviewed and sketched a concise rollout plan below (pulled into SOW_draft_Astra_v0.9.pdf attached). This is a lean timeline that assigns owners from Redwood and calls out acceptance criteria. Please review and flag any internal calendar conflicts.

Proposed milestone summary (dates are target; can shift by ±3 business days):

1) Integration kickoff & network review — 2028-02-20 — Owner: Vivek (Redwood) / Nisha (Astra)
   Acceptance: network diagram verified, egress IPs whitelisted
2) Staging deployment + smoke tests — 2028-03-05 — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood Infra) / Astra SE
   Acceptance: latency < 220ms P95, encryption & token path validated
3) Canary: 10% traffic — 2028-03-15 — Owner: Soojin Lee (Redwood CS) / Astra Ops
   Acceptance: error rate < 0.5%, metrics collection enabled
4) Full cutover (go-live) — 2028-03-22 — Owner: Marissa Cole (Customer Success) / Astra Prod
   Acceptance: SLA targets met for 7 consecutive hours, runbook exercised

Key asks for Astra before kickoff:
- Confirm go-live window preference (03/20–03/27)
- Share procurement ETA on reserved capacity and signed SOW by 2028-02-24

I've attached the SOW draft and a simple network diagram to match the MAP. If these dates work, I'll open a handoff ticket to CS and schedule the kickoff meeting.

Attachments: SOW_draft_Astra_v0.9.pdf (pdf, 112KB), network_diagram.png (png, 78KB)

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOW_draft_Astra_v0.9.pdf (pdf, 112KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Nisha Rao <nisha.rao@astralog.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: ACTION: Ownership & risk review for Astra MAP (internal)

Ben / Soojin —

Looping you both in to confirm owners and to capture any operational risks before we lock dates with Astra. Quick asks:

- Ben: can infra commit to a staging deployment by 2028-03-05? Any concerns on regional routing or IP whitelisting windows?
- Soojin: can CS run the canary and the 10% traffic runbook (including alerting thresholds)? Suggest we prepare a 48-hour on-call for the 03/15 canary day.

Minimum risk list I have so far:
- Procurement lag on reserved capacity (contingency: fallback to burst pool with higher cost)
- Network change approval delays in Astra's change window (contingency: extend staging window)

Please reply with quick thumbs-up or corrections. If OK, I will confirm 03/22 as the go-live and kick off the handoff doc.

Thanks,
Vivek

On Fri, Feb 10, 2028 at 1:12 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Liam —
> 
> Appreciate the MAP you sent. I reviewed and sketched a concise rollout plan below...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@astralog.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 17:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Integration roadmap, ownership, and go-live commitments

Liam / Nisha —

Thanks — confirming Redwood can meet the proposed schedule with the following clarifications and minor adjustments:

- Staging deployment will be ready by 2028-03-06 (one business-day buffer). Ben will be the technical owner for staging validation.
- We request Astra confirm IP whitelisting by 2028-02-23 to avoid last-minute firewall changes.
- Canary ops: Soojin will run the 10% canary on 03/15 and hold an on-call rotation (48 hrs) for observation.
- Acceptance checklist: we will require a 1-hour incident simulation during the canary window to validate runbooks.

Next steps:
1) Astra: sign SOW (we'll push a DocuSign link by EOD 02/16).
2) Redwood: open CS handoff and schedule the 60-minute kickoff for 02/20 10:00 PT (invite forthcoming).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/Astra-SOW-Draft
Attaching: network_diagram.png (reference)
Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Ben Carter
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: network_diagram.png (png, 78KB)]
